justification: Adds ten council clauses to the strict pick file that two independent blind graders marked as good clauses the strict readers had left out. Data only: the file is read by the loader (not run here) and by the claim checks. Directionality: more good clauses in ten boxes; it cannot add a wrong-type clause because each was already on the live brief, was graded good by a grader that did not know where it came from, and was read by me against the council's text; four graded-good clauses were left out for named reasons.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The picks file has a rank gap or repeat in any cell, a pick that is on the served skip list, a pick that was never scanned or is flagged in the heading scan, or a cell count other than 100 (10 councils x 10 topics).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: A blind side-by-side test on the production API (2026-11-10): for each of 89 council-topic cells, an independent grader saw the live list and the strict list as anonymous A and B and graded every clause good, partial or wrong for an ordinary house. Result: live 255 clauses, 42 percent good, 47 percent partial, 11 percent wrong (28); strict 120 clauses, 81 percent good, 19 percent partial, 0 wrong; cells with at least one good clause 72 live against 69 strict; preferred the live list in 7 cells, the strict list in 5, the same in 77.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The existing tests do not fail on a valid addition; they fail on a defect. Observed: the ten additions were first put in without the empty marker for Ku-ring-gai max_height removed; test_read_cells and the 100-cell check reported the cell as both picked and empty until the marker was replaced. With the corrected file: 50 passed across the two test files.

pre_impl.existing_data: 130 picks and 19 empty cells after this change, against 120 and 24 before. A dry run against the live table: 100 cells, 442 existing rows to delete, 130 to insert, nothing written. OC-29 and OC-30 hold on today's table (43 of 43) and with the picks swapped in memory (OC-29 95 percent over 43 cells; OC-30 41 of 43 = 95 percent, hold-out 17 of 17).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The strict readers were assumed to have kept every good clause. The blind test found 14 graded-good live clauses missing from the strict set, 10 of which are valid house clauses (for example Ku-ring-gai's 'maximum height of a dwelling is 9.5m', which the readers had dropped, and Penrith's two rules on how landscaped area is counted); the other four are one named-site rule (Ashfield, Haberfield), two Stanhope Gardens estate rules (Blacktown) and one design tip (Blacktown car parking).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new script or table: the same picks file the loader reads, with ten rows added after each cell's existing ranks and one empty-cell line replaced by its pick.

functions.name: plan_brief_picks_2026-11-10.jsonl additions
functions.what: Ten clauses appended to nine cells of the strict pick set.
functions.input: the graded-good live clauses missing from the strict set, chosen by hand from 14
functions.output: a pick file of 130 picks and 19 empty-cell lines
functions.if_none: without the additions the nine cells keep their strict picks and Ku-ring-gai max height stays empty
functions.edge_cases: ranks run 1 to n in each cell; no cell exceeds five; the Ku-ring-gai max height empty line is replaced by its pick.
functions.failure_mode: A wrong addition would show a clause that does not belong; each was read in the council's text and none is on the skip list.

break_it.scenario: A graded-good clause is for one named site.
break_it.what_happens: A rule for Haberfield or a Stanhope Gardens estate would show for every house.
break_it.how: The four site-specific or non-requirement clauses (Ashfield 163716, Blacktown 202411, 202430, 202444) were read and left out; the others were each read against the council's heading and text.
break_it.repro: compare data/plan_brief_picks_2026-11-10.jsonl with the 14 graded-good clauses listed in the PR

break_it.scenario: An addition is on the served skip list or unscanned.
break_it.what_happens: The page would drop it, or OC-29 would fail for an unread clause.
break_it.how: Two tests fail on a pick that is on the skip list or is unscanned or flagged in the heading scan.

break_it.scenario: The additions break the claim checks after the swap.
break_it.what_happens: Main would go red when the table changes, because CI reads the live table.
break_it.how: Both states were run with the real check code: today's table (43 of 43) and with the picks swapped in memory (41 of 43, 95 percent, hold-out 17 of 17).
break_it.repro: python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-29 and OC-30, then the same with the picks file substituted for the R2 house cells

break_it.scenario: The blind grader and the strict reader share a blind spot.
break_it.what_happens: Both are the same model family, so a mistake common to both would pass.
break_it.how: The graders saw anonymous lists without the picker's labels, and I read every addition against the council's text; a human or an independent academic check is still the right test (Thorpe sample).

verified: Blind live test, 89 cells in 10 councils: strict 81 percent good, 19 percent partial, 0 wrong; live 42, 47 and 11 percent; the 28 wrong live clauses are gone from the strict set.
OC-29 and OC-30 hold before the swap and after it, in memory. Loader dry run: 100 cells, 442 to delete, 130 to insert, nothing written.
50 tests pass across the loader and claim-check test files.
gaps: Cells with at least one good clause: live 72 of 89, strict 69, after these additions about 71. The two that remain are an Ashfield Haberfield-only rule and a Blacktown design tip, which are correctly absent.
The graders and the readers are the same model family and the test is blind but not independent of it.
The swap itself has not been run.

post_merge.db_reset: No data change from this PR. The swap that follows saves the old rows to a backup file and can be undone with --restore-from.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run python scripts/load_project_brief.py data/plan_brief_picks_2026-11-10.jsonl --replace-cells and read 130 to insert and Nothing written.
